name: Tohoku University
feeMethod: Charges one flat rate to all programmes, but from April 2027 students needing a student visa pay ¥900,000/yr instead of the domestic ¥535,800; the calculator uses the international rate plus the one-off admission fee.
description: Tohoku University is a national research university in Sendai, founded in 1907 as the third of Japan's imperial universities. In 2024 it became the first university designated a University for International Research Excellence by the Japanese government.
whyIncluded: Tohoku University is an NUS Student Exchange Programme partner, so NUS undergraduates can spend a semester studying in Sendai.

livingCosts.summary: Tohoku University's own monthly expense model for international students in Sendai: private apartment rent, utilities, food, phone and other spending, 12 months a year. Tohoku gives no transport figure, so that is the national survey average for the Tohoku region.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Tohoku University International Support Center 'International Student Expenses' page (undated, read 2026-10-08; model 'per-month expenses = housing + living expenses + tuition'): housing = apartment (1 bedroom) '40,000 and over', refined with the same office's 'Living cost' page (sup.bureau.tohoku.ac.jp/en/life-e/cost-e/) which gives international students' monthly rent excluding utilities as 40,000-60,000 (midpoint 50,000) + utilities (electricity/gas/water) 10,000 = 60,000 (dormitory single rooms are 13,000-33,900 plus a maintenance fee); food 40,000; personal = phone 10,000 + other 20,000 = 30,000 (the page's living-expenses subtotal is 80,000 excluding rent). Neither page prices transport, so transport = JASSO Lifestyle Survey of Privately Financed International Students, Tohoku region average commuting cost 2,000/month (table 7-4 of the FY2021 report, studyinjapan.go.jp/ja/_mt/2023/12/Seikatsu2021.pdf; the FY2023 report's regional breakdown could not be read in this session, only its Tohoku housing average of 26,000). The resulting 132,000 sits inside Tohoku's stated range of 80,000-150,000 a month. National Health Insurance and National Pension are required but unpriced on the page, so they are not included; tuition (44,650-67,000/month) excluded.

feeIncrease.reason: Tuition stood at ¥535,800 from 2024 to 2026 and steps to ¥900,000 for 2027 entrants, a one-off change; projecting that step every year would be wrong, so Japan's typical 3.1% a year applies after it.

programmes.name: Gateway College, Humanities and Social Sciences
programmes.feeBasis: Tohoku's new international-student tuition of ¥900,000/yr for undergraduate entrants from April 2027 (domestic students pay ¥535,800), plus the ¥282,000 admission fee; same for every faculty and programme.
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international (student-visa) students entering from April 2027, up from ¥535,800. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid in year 1. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Gateway College pamphlet (March 2026): new English-taught undergraduate programme from 2027 (April intake 88, October intake 90), all classes in English, broad fields Humanities & Social Sciences, Science & Engineering and Life Sciences, major chosen from year 3; lists ¥900,000 tuition for international (visa) students for the 2027 intake and ¥282,000 admission fee. Tohoku University Guide 2026-2027 leaflet (June 2026): from April 2027, tuition for new undergraduate and master's students who need a student visa ('international students') is ¥900,000 a year, against ¥535,800 for domestic students; admission fee ¥282,000 for both; application fee (¥17,000 undergraduate / ¥30,000 graduate) excluded. Students enrolled through 2026 keep ¥535,800 for the standard duration of their programme, recorded as the 2026 history row. Marked cohort-locked so 2026 entrants keep ¥535,800 while 2027 entrants pay ¥900,000 from year 1; the leaflet does not promise either rate for later years. Fix 2026-10-15: the 2027 step is excluded from the yearly increase via the university-level feeIncrease (3.1%). No 2024/2025 figure read. 2024 and 2025 not added (2026-10-13): Gateway College admits its first students in 2027, so there was no 2024 or 2025 intake. Round 5 (2026-10-13): 2024 and 2025 left blank as no-intake years (Gateway College's first intake is 2027).
